partners.mechanism_chain: VAPB (HGNC:12459) —LEADS_TO→ Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis type 8 (MONDO:0012077); STEAP3 (HGNC:25435) —DISRUPTS→ Heme biosynthesis pathway (REACT:R-HSA-70304); Heme biosynthesis pathway (REACT:R-HSA-70304) —DECREASES→ Heme (CHEBI:15901); Heme (CHEBI:15901) —LEADS_TO→ Severe congenital hypochromic anemia with ringed sideroblasts (MONDO:0014094); Heme (CHEBI:15901) —LEADS_TO→ Ringed sideroblasts (HP:0011017); Severe congenital hypochromic anemia with ringed sideroblasts (MONDO:0014094) —LEADS_TO→ Anemia (HP:0001892). Mutations in VAPB cause ALS8 through mechanisms not fully elucidated but potentially involving protein misfolding and cellular stress responses. Loss-of-function mutations in STEAP3 disrupt the reduction of ferric iron (Fe3+) to ferrous iron (Fe2+), a critical step in cellular iron uptake and utilization for heme biosynthesis. This impairment in heme synthesis leads to hypochromic anemia and the accumulation of ringed sideroblasts in erythroid precursors. The convergence lies in the cellular iron homeostasis and heme production pathway, where STEAP3 plays a direct role, and cellular stress from VAPB dysfunction could indirectly impact iron-dependent processes.
